# descope_company_groundcover_connector (Resource)

Manages a company-level groundcover connector that streams the audit events of the whole company. It requires a company management key, and a company can have only one company-level connector.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `endpoint` (String) The gRPC OTLP backend endpoint URL. Found in the groundcover console under Settings → Ingestion Keys → Backend Endpoints.
- `ingestion_key` (String, Sensitive) Third Party ingestion key for authenticating with groundcover. Create one in the groundcover console under Settings → Ingestion Keys (type: thirdParty).
- `name` (String) A custom name for your connector.

### Optional

- `audit_enabled` (Boolean) Whether to enable streaming of audit events.
- `description` (String) A description of what your connector is used for.
- `disabled` (Boolean) Whether the connector is disabled. This can be used to temporarily stop a connector from executing without fully deleting it.
- `environment_name` (String) Name of the environment tag.
- `mask_pii` (Boolean) Whether to mask personally identifiable information in the logs. Learn more about what is masked: https://docs.descope.com/audit-trails-and-integrations/masking-pii-in-audit-logs
- `service_name` (String) Name of the service tag.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
